name: Yumimi Mix
source:
Yumimi Yoshizawa is an ordinary high school girl. She lives an ordinary but enjoyable high school life with her childhood friends, Sakurako and Shinichi.
One day, mysterious objects appear in front of Yumimi on her way to school. From this day onward, strange things begin to happen one after another...
translation:
吉泽弓美是个普通的女高中生。她和青梅竹马樱子、真一，一起过着平凡却愉快的校园生活。
某天，上学途中的弓美面前，出现了神秘的物体。从这一天起，奇怪的事情接连发生……
